name: abi-compat-probe
proves: The compatibility gate is chosen from VERIFIED legacy behavior. The legacy resolver at 952d92da5131d6ab595b45b3bf18bc7ce3b3466d (packages/ui-svelte/src/document/extensions.ts, resolveSvelteExtension) reads only id/revision/events/slots/rendererImplementationId: it silently ignores abi/outputs and ACCEPTS an output-wired descriptor unless events carries the ABI marker; with the marker it rejects with the existing UI_RENDER_EXTENSION_INTERFACE_UNSUPPORTED. This is a resolver-level reproduction (disposable external harness, production files unmodified) - NOT a browser rendering test. Cases C1-C5 were executed 5/5 against the exact legacy bytes; the recorded outcomes below are the probe results.

legacyReference.bytes: exact extraction from the named commit, unmodified

cases.case: ORIGINAL ACCEPTED COUNTEREXAMPLE - the frozen checkbox-valid descriptor as first published (abi + outputs, NO events/slots) with a matching legacy implementation
cases.input: descriptor: the pre-repair fixture descriptor (id vict.catalog.checkbox, revision 1, abi vict.ui-component-abi@1, outputs [checkedChange:boolean], rendererImplementationId vict.svelte.catalog, no events, no slots)
cases.expectedLegacyOutcome: ACCEPTED (ok:true, no diagnostic) - proving abi/outputs are invisible to the legacy gate; the original 68e166f freeze matrix row was wrong

cases.case: REPAIRED GATE - same descriptor with events ["vict.ui-component-abi@1"]
cases.expectedLegacyOutcome: REJECTED with UI_RENDER_EXTENSION_INTERFACE_UNSUPPORTED (the existing fail-closed diagnostic, raised by the legacy resolver itself)

cases.case: legacy props-only descriptor (no events/slots/abi/outputs) with a matching legacy implementation
cases.input: descriptor: {id legacy.widget, revision 1, props [{label:string}], rendererImplementationId vict-svelte}

cases.case: control: legacy descriptor declaring an untyped event
cases.expectedLegacyOutcome: REJECTED with UI_RENDER_EXTENSION_INTERFACE_UNSUPPORTED (existing fail-closed behavior, unchanged)

cases.case: control: fixture descriptor with no implementation registered

note: The repaired fixtures declare the events marker on every component-ABI descriptor (checkbox-valid, select-valid, button-action, dialog-slot, appshell-content). render-failures case "old plan artifact for an abi@1 descriptor" adds the new-renderer rejection of pre-amendment compile output.
